Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Vinod - 35 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Kavita - 57 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Sanjay - 66 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater
4. Ajay - 34 years, friend
Look: white kurta-pyjama

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The forest - tall trees, thick bushes

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Vinod stands by the road. Kavita and Sanjay stand near him.]

Sanjay: "Let's do something fun today."

[Vinod rides his motorbike to the market.]

Vinod (laughing): "This is amazing!"

[Vinod starts his scooter and rides off.]

Vinod: "That's great!"

[Vinod drives the car to the office.]

Sanjay: "I'm ready!"

[Vinod gets out of the car.]

Vinod: "Well done!"

[Vinod rides the scooter with Mother sitting behind him.]

Sanjay: "One more time!"

[Vinod takes Mother to the market on his motorbike, she sits behind him.]

Vinod: "That's easy."

Scene 2: The forest - Day

[Vinod stands in the forest. Kavita stands near him.]

Vinod: "Let's begin."

[Vinod goes hunting and aims his bow at a deer.]

Vinod: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Vinod rides an elephant through the forest.]

Kavita: "I really enjoyed today."
